observation_indicators.observable_fil: Kinikilala ang concern nang walang paninisi; nagbibigay ng isang tamang hakbang sa saklaw ng BHW; nagtatanong ng sariling paliwanag; inaayos ang maling pagkaunawa at muling sinusuri; sinasabi ang hindi pa kumpirmado.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Acknowledges the concern without blame; gives one correct step within the BHW role; invites an explanation in the person’s own words; repairs misunderstanding and checks again; states what is unconfirmed.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Walang direktang ebidensiya ng pagtatangka, o nagbibigay ng diagnosis, paggamot o garantiyang serbisyo, o inaantala ang agarang tulong. Itala ang eksaktong kulang o hindi ligtas; ipamodel at ipaulit.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: No direct evidence of an attempt, or gives a diagnosis, treatment or guaranteed service, or delays immediate help. Record the missing or unsafe action; model and retry.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kinikilala ang concern nang walang paninisi; nagbibigay ng isang tamang hakbang sa saklaw ng BHW; nagtatanong ng sariling paliwanag; inaayos ang maling pagkaunawa at muling sinusuri; sinasabi ang hindi pa kumpirmado. Nagagawa nang walang prompt sa direktang naobserbahang pagtatangka.
levels.kaya_na_en: Acknowledges the concern without blame; gives one correct step within the BHW role; invites an explanation in the person’s own words; repairs misunderstanding and checks again; states what is unconfirmed. Performs without prompting in a directly observed attempt.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Angkop ang hakbang ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa teach-back, repair o recheck; halimbawa, pagtango lamang ang unang check. Itala ang tulong at ipaulit nang malaya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: The step is appropriate but teach-back, repair or recheck needs prompting; for example, initially checks only for a nod. Record support and arrange an independent retry.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Walang direktang ebidensiya ng pagtatangka, o nagbibigay ng diagnosis, paggamot o garantiyang serbisyo, o inaantala ang agarang tulong. Itala ang eksaktong kulang o hindi ligtas; ipamodel at ipaulit.
levels.hindi_pa_en: No direct evidence of an attempt, or gives a diagnosis, treatment or guaranteed service, or delays immediate help. Record the missing or unsafe action; model and retry.
